item.text: The concrete correctness gap is cross-instance concurrency: the current count-then-insert transaction is only synchronized per JDBC connection, so two notifier instances can both observe fewer than two sends and exceed the cap. I’m adding a per-customer database lock row, preserving the existing sent/capped contract and documenting the invariant in tests.
